underfeed.definition:
v. t. To feed with too little food; to supply with an
   insufficient quantity of food.
underfeed.translation:
vt. 未喂饱, 从底部给(炉子等)加燃料
[机] 从下面送的, 下面给进

underfelt.definition: n a carpet pad of thick felt

underfelting.definition:
-ing form of underfelt
n a carpet pad of thick felt
underfelting.translation: (underfelt 的现在分词) n. （垫在地毯下的）地毯垫

underfilling.definition:
n. The filling below or beneath; the under part of a
   building.
underfilling.translation: 不[未充]满, 底层填料

underfinanced.translation: a. 资金短缺的,财力不足的

underfired.translation: 焙烧不足的(陶器等), 下部[自下]燃烧的, 下加热式的, 欠火[锻]的

underfoot.definition:
r. under the feet
r. in the way and hindering progress
underfoot.translation:
adv. 在脚下, 碍事地
[经] 少计总额

underframe.definition: n the internal supporting structure that gives an artifact its shape

underframes.definition:
-s form of underframe
n the internal supporting structure that gives an artifact its shape
underframes.translation: (underframe 的第三人称 -s形式) 底架[框], 底座

underframing.translation: 底层框架的材料或结构部件

underfrequency.translation: 降低了的频率, 最低的频率, 低于额定频率

underfunding.translation: vt. 对…提供的资金不足

underfur.definition: n thick soft fur lying beneath the longer and coarser guard hair
